role: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil cadet (Melbourne)
subject: Expression of interest: graduate civil engineer or civil cadet, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to a dated advert. Your graduates page lists civil engineering graduates and cadets and invites a CV and cover letter at this address, so I am registering my interest in a graduate civil or civil cadet role in Melbourne.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work.

Building and maintaining safer civil infrastructure for local communities is the work I want to grow in. My Australian design work so far is from study, so I would start at graduate or cadet level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you keep me in mind for a graduate civil or civil cadet opening?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to a dated graduate advert. Your Cadet Pathway page describes a Graduate role for final year students, and your vacancy pages publish this careers address for applications, so I am registering interest in a graduate civil role with Daracon.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation for the right role and available for site and regional work.

Subdivision, road and civil construction delivery is the work I want to grow in. I am not currently on your cadet pathway, so I would start at graduate level if you have capacity.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you keep me in mind for a graduate civil opening or advise the best next step on your pathway?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
